verification_candidates.claim_text: Prescribed medications for ADD and ADHD are stimulants.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: You can be taking all of these prescribed medications for ADD, ADHD, and they are stimulants
verification_candidates.rationale: Classifying ADHD medications as stimulants is checkable and frames the warning that follows.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Phenomene is a stimulant taken for weight loss.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: You can be taking Phenomene because you want to lose weight
verification_candidates.rationale: Whether the named weight-loss product is a stimulant is checkable and relevant to its risks.

verification_candidates.evidence_quote: It's also going to start messing with your blood sugar
verification_candidates.rationale: A causal claim about stimulants and glucose regulation that listeners could act on.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Stimulant drugs tax the adrenal glands to pump out more cortisol, and eventually the adrenals fail.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: you're going to start taxing your adrenals to pump out more cortisol and eventually they will fail
verification_candidates.rationale: Central adrenal-fatigue claim; checkable against endocrinology evidence.

verification_candidates.claim_text: When adrenal glands fail, the body enters a low cortisol state with extreme fatigue all day.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: when they fail, now you're in a low cortisol state. Now you are extreme fatigued all day long
verification_candidates.rationale: Predicts a specific syndrome from adrenal failure.

verification_candidates.claim_text: People who need Adderall to function are physically addicted to a stimulant.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: your body is literally addicted to a stimulant to just get through your day
verification_candidates.rationale: Claim of physical dependence on Adderall; checkable and stigmatizing.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Weaning off stimulants causes deep exhaustion and fatigue.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: You're going to go through some deep exhaustion, some bad fatigue times
verification_candidates.rationale: Withdrawal symptom claim that affects whether patients stop stimulants.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Stimulant users need increasing amounts to keep functioning over time.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: But then you need more to keep going throughout the rest of your life
verification_candidates.rationale: Tolerance claim underlying the warning against ADHD stimulants.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Long-term stimulant use taxes the cardiovascular system.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: eventually it's going to start taxing your cardiovascular system
verification_candidates.rationale: Cardiovascular risk claim about stimulant use.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Under stress, the adrenal glands steal progesterone and pregnenolone to make cortisol, causing those hormones to drop.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: they start stealing progesterone and pregnenolone to make the cortisol. Those two drop down
verification_candidates.rationale: Specific hormone-stealing mechanism that can be checked against endocrine physiology.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Taking T3 when cortisol is low causes heart palpitations and anxiety.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: You actually get heart palpitations and anxiety when you add in T3
verification_candidates.rationale: A drug-safety claim about thyroid hormone replacement.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Most low cortisol is caused by stress, stimulant use, and taxing the adrenals, not by Addison's disease.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Normally, when we see low cortisol, it's from what I just talked about
verification_candidates.rationale: Attribution of low cortisol prevalence to adrenal fatigue rather than Addison's is checkable.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Addison's disease is an autoimmune disorder in which the adrenal glands do not produce enough cortisol.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Addison's is an actual disorder, a diagnosable disorder that occurs when the adrenal glands just they don't produce enough cortisol. And it's an autoimmune condition
verification_candidates.rationale: Medical definitional claim about Addison's disease.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Thyroid Fixer works at the mitochondrial level to increase cellular ATP production.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: how it actually works at the mitochondrial level to kick up those cells a notch, to kick up the cellular energy of ATP
verification_candidates.rationale: Product efficacy claim about a named supplement.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Higher ATP production improves metabolism, and low ATP production causes low metabolism.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: That ATP is going to improve your metabolism. If you have low ATP production, you're going to have a low metabolism
verification_candidates.rationale: Mechanistic claim linking ATP to metabolic rate.

verification_candidates.claim_text: ATP production cannot really be tested and must be assessed by symptoms.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: there's not really a way to test that. your ATP production
verification_candidates.rationale: A checkable claim about the availability of ATP testing.

verification_candidates.claim_text: CoQ10 and L-carnitine are good supplements for improving mitochondrial function.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: CoQ10 is a really good one. L-carnitine is an excellent one
verification_candidates.rationale: Supplement efficacy claims that listeners could act on.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Oral NAD supplements are poorly absorbed or cannot be used to make NAD.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: you can't really absorb or make NAD from... taking a supplement
verification_candidates.rationale: A bioavailability claim about oral NAD products, marked by hearsay.
